chunks: And whatever is in it from al-Mīthamī, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Ziyād, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Mīthamī.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: al-Ṣaffār, one of the transmitters in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْمِيثَمِيِّ: al-Mīthamī, the narrator to whom this transmission path leads
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicates direct transmission by the author through this chain
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ: a transmitter in the chain leading to Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Mīthamī

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Mīthamī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the transmission chain through which the author narrates reports from al-Mīthamī. Its significance lies in documenting the sanad/isnad for hadith attribution in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
